contexts.text: To build () = to raise up what is fallen. AC 153.
In the Word, to build is predicated of evils; to erect, of falsities; and to renew of both. Illustrated.
He built Nineveh etc. () = that thus he formed for himself doctrinal things of faith.
Let us build us a city and a tower () = that they fashioned a doctrine and a worship. AC 1313.
They ceased to build the city () = that such a doctrine was not received.
He built an altar = worship. AC 1618.

To collect scientifics and by their means rear up the external man, and build him, is not unlike building a house; wherefore building and building houses have a similar signification in the Word. Illustrated.
Perchance I shall be built up by her () = that thus the Rational can be born...
They seem to themselves to be building small cities...
Preface [2]. Rock = this faith; upon this the Church is built.
To build an altar () = to prepare the Divine Human. Explained.
To build a house without righteousness, and chambers without judgment () = to put together what is religious from what is not good and not true.
I shall also be built up by her () = that thus it will have life. To be built up = not to die, thus to rise again, or live.

(Jacob) built himself a house () = the increase of good from truth in that state. To build a house = to instruct the external man in intelligence and wisdom; and as intelligence is of truth and wisdom of good, to build a house, here = the increase of good from truth.
To build a tower () = to procure for themselves interior truths.
To build the waste cities () = to rectify the falsified doctrinal things of truth.
Illustrated by the building of houses... TCR 152.
The builders () = those who are of the Church. HH 534:end. AE 417:end.
To build chambers without judgment = to imbue things which are not true.
To build Jerusalem () = to renew the Church. AE 375:17. AE 684:36.
If they have been priests they want to build... But what they build by day falls down at night. TCR 281:8.
On those who desire to build.
Those afar off who will build in the temple of Jehovah () = that those who formerly had been removed from the truths and goods of the Church will accede to the Church.
To build the walls of Jerusalem () = to restore the Church by leading into the good of love, and teaching in the truths of doctrine.
The restoration of the Church and of doctrine is signified by being inhabited, and built ().
Under House, see this reference.
He shall build my city () = that he will restore the doctrine of truth.
Occurs. AE 811:19.
